title: 577. Super Washing Machines

examples.explanation: The average is 2. The left machine needs 1 more and the right one must give 3 away; balancing takes 3 moves.
The average is 1. Both outer machines pull one garment from the middle, finishing in 2 moves.

hints: If the total is not divisible by n, answer -1; otherwise each machine targets total / n garments.
Scan left to right tracking the running imbalance; a machine's bottleneck is the larger of its own surplus/deficit and the flow passing through it.
